title: Covenant Logistics Named a Top Company for Women to Work in Trucking 2026
summary: Recognition Highlights Company’s Ongoing Commitment to Empowering Women and Building an Inclusive Workplace
body_markdown:
Covenant Logistics is proud to announce that it has been recognized as a[Top Company for Women to Work in Trucking by the Women In Trucking Association (WIT)](https://www.womenintrucking.org/press-releases/women-in-trucking-association-names-2026-top-companies-for-women-to-work-in-trucking) and Redefining the Road magazine. This honor reflects Covenant’s continued commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace culture where women are empowered to grow, lead, and build meaningful careers across all areas of the transportation and logistics industry.


The annual recognition highlights companies that demonstrate a strong commitment to gender diversity, supportive workplace cultures, professional development opportunities, competitive benefits, and career advancement pathways for women. Companies recognized by Women In Trucking are evaluated on characteristics including corporate culture, flexible work practices, compensation, and opportunities.


Covenant's annual Women of Covenant Conference has become a cornerstone of these efforts. The conference brings together women from across the enterprise for several days of leadership development, mentorship, collaboration, and inspiration. In addition, the company celebrates outstanding female leaders through its annual Women of the Year Awards, recognizing exceptional contributions from professional drivers, warehouse team members, and in-house professionals.


> “This recognition is an affirmation of the culture we've worked hard to build at Covenant.” said Joey Ballard, Chief People and Safety Officer, “We are committed to providing meaningful career opportunities, investing in our people, and creating an environment where our team members can thrive at every stage of their careers. We're proud of the progress we've made and remain focused on continuing that work.”


The company has also implemented programs and workplace enhancements that reflect its commitment to supporting women throughout their careers, including career advancement opportunities, ongoing education and development programs, and family-focused initiatives. These investments have helped create a culture where employees are empowered to lead, grow, and succeed together.


Women In Trucking’s mission is to encourage the employment of women in the trucking industry, promote their accomplishments, and minimize the obstacles they face. Covenant shares that vision and remains focused on cultivating a workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and where women are empowered to make a meaningful impact on the future of transportation and logistics.
